gates.title: Connect Slack to your coding agent
gates.detail: Sign the agent into Slack. Write down the workspace and the channel this demo should use. The agent drafts the message. Sending it waits on that channel.

gates.title: Approve the Slack app
gates.detail: Install or approve the Slack app in the workspace admin settings. An agent cannot click an admin approval prompt.

gates.title: Connect a Salesforce demo org
gates.detail: Sign the agent into a demo, sandbox, or developer org where you can create accounts and cases. If that org requires a hosted MCP server, create the external client app in Setup and finish the login in your agent.

gates.title: Mark the demo org and the production orgs
gates.detail: Copy demos/org.example.json to demos/org.local.json. Set demoOrgLabel to the demo org's company name. List every production org under productionOrgLabels. Skip this step when the file is already filled in.

gates.title: Check the trial date
gates.detail: If the demo org is a trial, put trialExpires in demos/org.local.json as YYYY-MM-DD. Renew or replace the org when that date is near. Skip this when the org does not expire.

gates.title: Create new objects, fields, or Apex yourself
gates.detail: This brief asks for metadata. Add it in Salesforce Setup, or take it out of the flow. The agent creates records on objects the org already has.
